title: Facet force at L2-L3, L3-L4 - Botolin S, Puttlitz C, Baldini T et al. 2011 (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet force, mean +/- SD, average of left and right facets (pressure-sensitive film); rotations applied to T12-L5 (displacement control)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.n: not stated in review (see primary: Botolin S, Puttlitz C, Baldini T et al. 2011)
source.sample: human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Botolin S, Puttlitz C, Baldini T et al. 2011, as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Rotation-controlled: 10 deg lateral / 10 deg axial / 15 deg flexion / 15 deg extension applied across T12-L5.
how_to_simulate: Model T12-L5, impose total rotation 10 deg (LB, AR) or 15 deg (flexion, extension)
Report facet force at L2-L3 and L3-L4 as mean of left and right facets
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (the user's own review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Botolin S, Puttlitz C, Baldini T et al. 2011.

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
